title: Finance Manager - AI Native (m/f/d)
description: 🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job! At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people . Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact. Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload. As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission! 💡 Your Mission: Build the financial engine for our next stage of growth As an AI-Native Finance Manager , you will play a key role in building and scaling our Finance function as voize continues to grow internationally. This is a broad, high-ownership role combining FP&A, business partnering, accounting, finance operations, and finance engineering . You will own important financial processes from budgeting and forecasting to management reporting and preparatory accounting, while working closely with teams across the business to turn financial data into better decisions. At the same time, you'll build a modern, technology-enabled Finance function . You'll connect systems, improve data flows, automate repetitive processes, and leverage AI wherever it can make Finance more efficient and scalable. As we expand internationally, you'll also gain exposure to multiple entities, local GAAPs, and different accounting requirements. We're looking for someone who enjoys both the numbers and the systems behind them — someone who doesn't just run finance processes, but constantly asks how we can build them better. 🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning , providing clear insights into business performance, risks, and opportunities, and act as a finance business partner to teams across voize. Drive financial reporting and analysis , building models, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leadership and teams understand performance and make better decisions. Own and improve operational finance processes , including preparatory accounting, invoice and expense workflows, reconciliations, payment processes, and month-end preparation. Build and improve our Finance stack , connecting systems and data, automating recurring processes, and using tools such as Spendesk, ERP/accounting systems, BI tools, and AI to reduce manual work. Support our international growth , working with external accounting partners across countries and gaining exposure to different GAAPs, statutory requirements, and international finance operations. 🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in Finance, FP&A, Controlling, Accounting, or a similar role , with solid accounting knowledge and practical bookkeeping experience. Strong analytical and commercial thinking , with the ability to understand financial drivers, challenge assumptions, and turn numbers into clear recommendations. A strong systems mindset: you enjoy understanding how finance processes, systems, and data fit together and naturally look for ways to make them simpler, more reliable, and scalable. Strong AI & automation capabilities: Hands-on experience using AI and automation to redesign and improve Finance workflows, not just as productivity tools, but to automate repetitive work, improve analysis, and build more scalable processes. Able to identify high-impact use cases and implement practical solutions independently. Modern finance systems & tools: Hands-on experience working with ERP/accounting systems and modern Finance tools. Experience with Spendesk, BI/reporting tools, or workflow automation platforms is a plus. nanuq elektrifiziert den Schwerlast- und Flottenverkehr. Wir planen, bauen und betreiben Ladeinfrastruktur für Logistik- und Speditionsunternehmen, vom Depot mit vier Ladepunkten bis zum Ladepark mit Megawattanschluss. Dazu kommen Photovoltaik und Batteriespeicher, gesteuert über unsere eigene Softwareplattform arctiqOS. Unser Modell: Truck Charging as a Service. Der Kunde bekommt eine funktionierende Ladeinfrastruktur, wir übernehmen Planung, Bau, Betrieb und Finanzierung.

Wir wachsen schnell, und mit uns die Zahl und Größe der Projekte. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der unsere Angebote und Projekte sauber durchrechnet, bevor sie rausgehen.

Aufgaben

  • Du kalkulierst unsere Projekte von der ersten Grobeinschätzung im Vertrieb bis zum verbindlichen Angebot: Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Hardware, Montage, Inbetriebnahme
  • Du erstellst Massenermittlungen und Leistungsverzeichnisse auf Basis von Lageplänen, Netzanschlussauskünften und Bedarfsermittlungen
  • Du holst Nachunternehmer- und Lieferantenangebote ein, vergleichst sie und arbeitest sie in die Kalkulation ein
  • Du kalkulierst die Betreibermodelle mit: Investitionskosten, Betriebskosten über die Laufzeit, Ladepreise und Wirtschaftlichkeit für Kunde und für uns
  • Du pflegst und entwickelst unsere Kalkulationsgrundlagen weiter, also Preisspiegel, Aufwandswerte, Kostenkennwerte, und sorgst dafür, dass sie aktuell bleiben
  • Du kalkulierst Nachträge und Änderungen während der Projektabwicklung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Vertrieb, Projektabwicklung und Einkauf zusammen und bist die Instanz, die sagt, ob eine Zahl trägt
  • Nach der Umsetzung schaust du dir Soll und Ist an und ziehst daraus die Lehren für die nächste Kalkulation

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Bauingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Versorgungstechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Kalkulation von Bau- oder Elektroprojekten, gerne aus dem Anlagenbau, Elektrohandwerk, Tiefbau, der Energiewirtschaft oder von einem Generalunternehmer
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Leistungsverzeichnissen, Massenermittlung und VOB
  • Du bist fit in Excel und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Tools ein, bei uns unter anderem Odoo und Reonic
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und weißt, dass eine Kalkulation nicht nur richtig, sondern auch verkaufbar sein muss
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und sauber, auch wenn drei Angebote gleichzeitig raus müssen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse für den Austausch mit Herstellern und Lieferanten

Schön, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit Ladeinfrastruktur, Photovoltaik oder Batteriespeichern
  • Kenntnisse rund um Netzanschlüsse, TAB und Anmeldeprozesse beim Netzbetreiber
  • Erfahrung mit Förderprogrammen für Ladeinfrastruktur
  • Erfahrung mit Betreiber- oder Contractingmodellen

Benefits

  • Eine Position mit direktem Einfluss auf die Zahlen des Unternehmens, kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung
  • Ein Thema mit Rückenwind: die Elektrifizierung des Schwerlastverkehrs steht am Anfang, du gestaltest sie mit
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau unserer Kalkulationsprozesse, statt in fertige Strukturen einzurücken
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten
  • Ein Team, das lieber pragmatisch löst als lange abstimmt

Klingt nach dir?

Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht, ein paar Sätze zu deinen bisherigen Projekten reichen uns völlig.

You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.</p> <p>This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. <strong>You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.</strong></p> <p><strong>The Work You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Initiate and Connect</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases</li> <li>Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria</li> <li>Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build &amp; While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Qualifications You Need</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 7+ years minimum in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators.</li> <li><strong>Platform skills:&nbsp;</strong>Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.</li> <li><strong>AI fluency: </strong>Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Business and process domain expertise : </strong>Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Consulting skills: </strong>Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

Every machine learning model KAYAK ships depends on reliable, scalable infrastructure to move from experiment to production — and that's exactly what this role makes possible. KAYAK is seeking a Senior MLOps Engineer who will focus on the design and implementation of our machine learning infrastructure and production lifecycle. This is a senior, hands-on role where you will bridge the gap between data science and production engineering.

You will join the Machine Learning Platform team and be responsible for building and maintaining scalable infrastructure & automated pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring, ensuring our ML models are reliable, reproducible, and performant. You will work closely with Data Scientists, ML Engineering and Operations teams to transform experimental code into robust, production-ready services at scale.

This role requires commuting to the Berlin office 3 times a week.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain ML infrastructure end-to-end: Extend and operate the infrastructure that powers every model we ship — including CI/CD pipelines, model orchestration, and automated training pipelines designed to scale reliably without manual intervention.

  • Own model deployment and serving: Help define and evolve the standards and tooling for model serving, ensuring low latency and high availability across our ML services.

  • Develop core MLOps capabilities: Establish and maintain essential infrastructure that functions as reliable, self-service systems for the entire machine learning organization — with a focus on feature stores, model registries, and automated monitoring for performance and data drift.

  • Operationalize infrastructure for the ML team: Collaborate with Operations to enable Kubernetes (k8s) autoscaling and GPU provisioning, turning these into accessible, self-service tools for ML practitioners — including standing up and operating a Kubernetes-based development cluster and taking models from experimentation to GPU-backed production.

  • Improve platform reliability and performance: Partner with Operations to design resilient monitoring using advanced observability tooling. Define service-level objectives and implement automation to reduce manual interventions and improve system reliability.

  • Empower Data Scientists through standardized, optimized workflows: Amplify the impact of the ML team by building clear, well-supported "golden paths" — standardized workflows that streamline the model development lifecycle and let Data Scientists focus on modeling while you handle the infrastructure.

Please apply if you have:

  • Familiarity with ML lifecycle tooling, including orchestration frameworks, feature stores, model registries, and drift or performance monitoring.

You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work rather than absorb it.

ABOUT OUR COMPANY
 
We are an engineering organization. Our mission is to “Ship great software” and build custom, large-scale software platforms on time, on budget and on target. 
 
In over two decades, we have never failed to deliver what we promised. 
 
85% of our members are software engineers with a background in computer science, physics or mathematics, many also with a strong background in machine learning.
 
freiheit.com technologies was founded in Hamburg in the midst of the first internet boom in the last millennium in 1999. Since then, we’ve been building custom software platforms and helping our clients to create their future business models based on software.
 
For over a quarter of a century, we have been working for the "Who's Who" of German and European industrial and commercial companies. Retail, automotive, e-commerce, healthcare and more.
 
Our large-scale software platforms are used by millions of users every day. Each product has a business-critical, strategic relevance for our customers.
 
We have a team of 250+ employees from 30+ nations in our engineering hubs in Hamburg and Lisbon. 
 
We make “mission impossible” possible and very often create things that no one has ever built before.
 
Our teams work data-driven to constantly optimize their own productivity by removing friction from their work. Each member takes on end-to-end responsibility for their work. To be successful, you need to be productive. To be productive, you need to be efficient and effective.
 
Technology never rests. Neither do we.
 
 
ABOUT YOUR JOB
 
· You start in one of our engineering teams. Team size is maximum five people.
· You will receive a lot of introductory training in the first weeks about the technologies you are going to use in your project.
The trainings are conducted by software engineers from our own company.
· You are involved in every part of the software engineering process and in the lifecycle of the services that your team is building -
design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, operations and improving software based on user feedback and usage
data.
· You work closely with our customers to iteratively improve their product offering by conceiving, refining and delivering new ideas.
 
 
ABOUT YOU
 
Qualifications:
 
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related fields like Mathematics or Physics
· Experience in C/C++, Python or Java
· Ability to learn fast 
 
Bonus skills or interests:
 
· Master or PhD in Computer Science or related fields like Mathematics or Physics
· Algorithms and data structures, understanding time & space complexity
· Experience in Go, Kotlin, TypeScript or JavaScript
· Experience in front end development, like ReactJS, Angular, Vue or Flutter/Dart
· Functional programming with Common Lisp, Clojure or Haskell
· Experience working with distributed systems in the Cloud
· Experience in Machine Learning and Data Science
· Competitive Programming
ABOUT OUR COMMUNITY
 
If you ask anyone why they work here, it's pretty likely that they will say “because of the people” and “because I've never learned so much in my life”.
 
We believe that productive people are happy people. 
 
In our engineering hubs in Hamburg and Lisbon, you will meet smart, nice, ambitious people from all over the world. 
 
Becoming a well-rounded professional in your field of expertise is a long journey that takes many years of hard work and learning. Our company is the best place to become that person. 
 
Being a member of our company will ask a lot of you and no one can do the work for you. We will set high expectations for you and provide you with the skills and successful behaviors needed to meet them.
 
Here you have the opportunity to work with intelligent people on interesting tasks and complete projects from idea to operations - end to end.
 
Our company is a place where you can become the best version of yourself. 
 
DO YOU WANT TO BE PART OF OUR TEAM?
 
Then send us your complete application documents (curriculum vitae and references) via our application portal. And if you have any questions about your application or the application process Bianca Mioc is available to you personally on +49 40/890584-0.

title: VP/Head of Engineering (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Volle technische Verantwortung für Rocket — direkt an die Gründer, ohne Zwischenebene tack von Marriott. Unsere Engineers arbeiten also mitten im echten Hotelbetrieb, nicht gegen Sandbox-APIs. In dieser Rolle verantwortest du Engineering bei MICE DESK — vollständig. Es gibt keine CTO-Ebene über dir: Architektur, Technik, Delivery und Team liegen bei dir, und du berichtest direkt an die Gründer. Das ist eine Hands-on-Führungsrolle. Du führst das Engineering-Team inklusive unserer AI-/Data-Funktion, verantwortest die Schnittstelle zu Product und stehst für alles gerade, was ausgeliefert wird. Engineering, end-to-end. Architektur, System-Design, Delivery gegen die Roadmap, Zuverlässigkeit, technische Schuld. Backend, Frontend, DevOps, QA und das AI-/Data-Team laufen bei dir zusammen. Du setzt schlanke Prozesse, mit denen ein kleines Team schnell liefert, ohne Dinge zu zerbrechen. Eine AI-gestützte Engineering-Pipeline. Wir bauen nicht nur AI-Produkte — wir bauen mit AI. Du machst die Engineering-Organisation selbst AI-nativ: agentische Coding-Workflows, AI-gestützte Reviews und Tests, Automatisierung von allem Wiederkehrenden. Ein kleines Team soll liefern wie ein dreimal so großes — das wahr zu machen ist dein Job. AI als Kernfähigkeit des Systems. Du architektierst die Integration von LLMs und agentischen Workflows in Produktivsysteme: deterministische Logik kombiniert mit AI-generierten Ergebnissen, mit echter Validierung, Fallbacks und Zuverlässigkeitsstrategien. Der Hotelbetrieb läuft auf unserer Plattform — Nicht-Determinismus ist keine Entschuldigung für Unzuverlässigkeit. Das Team. Einstellen, entwickeln, skalieren. Du übernimmst ein starkes kleines Team und machst daraus eine leistungsstarke Engineering-Organisation mit einer Kultur aus Ownership und Tempo. Auch unsere verteilte Hiring-Strategie über mehrere Standorte hinweg liegt bei dir. Product- und Business-Alignment. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und Product. Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, vereinfachst Komplexität und verbindest Engineering-Arbeit mit Ergebnissen: Umsatz, Automatisierung, Kundenwirkung. Mit dem US-Markteintritt muss Engineering mit Enterprise-Kunden auf zwei Kontinenten Schritt halten. Woran wir Erfolg messen: 6 Monate: Delivery ist planbar, die AI-gestützte Dev-Pipeline läuft, und das Team ist um A-Player gewachsen, die du eingestellt hast. 12 Monate: Die Plattform skaliert mit US-Enterprise-Kunden, die Kernsysteme sind zuverlässig und observierbar, und Engineering ist ein Wettbewerbsvorteil — kein Flaschenhals. Ehrlich gesagt: Das ist volle Verantwortung ohne Netz darüber. Keine CTO-Ebene, die Entscheidungen abnimmt oder abfängt — die Architektur, das Team und alles, was ausgeliefert wird, sind deins. Wenn du eine Rolle suchst, in der jemand über dir die Richtung vorgibt, ist das nicht deine Stelle. Wenn du genau diese Verantwortung willst, ist es die richtige. Dein Profil 10+ Jahre Software Engineering, davon 5+ in einer Engineering-Führungsrolle in wachstumsstarken Produktunternehmen. Starker Hands-on-Hintergrund in Backend oder Full-Stack — du kannst noch selbst in die Tiefe gehen. Nachweisliche Erfahrung, Engineering-Teams in wachsenden Startups zu skalieren. Starke Architektur-Expertise: APIs, verteilte Systeme, Event-Driven Design, Cloud. LLM-/agentische AI-Systeme in Produktion — und eine echte Überzeugung, dass Engineering selbst AI-gestützt gehört. Product-Mindset: Du verbindest technische Entscheidungen mit geschäftlichen Ergebnissen. Souverän im Umgang mit Ambiguität, Tempo und voller Verantwortung. Ein Pluspunkt, kein Muss: Hintergrund in Hospitality-Tech, CRM, PMS oder Revenue Management. Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integrationen (Salesforce, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Microsoft Graph API). Erfahrung in der Führung verteilter, internationaler Teams. Warum wir? Wir sind das Technologieunternehmen, das den Gruppen- und Veranstaltungsverkauf in der Hotellerie neu denkt. Was heute über Posteingang, Excel und Telefon läuft, macht unsere Plattform Rocket zu einem durchgängigen, KI-gestützten Prozess — von der ersten Anfrage bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag. Europäische Hotelgruppen führen ihren Gruppenverkauf bereits darüber. Das bedeutet für dich: Du arbeitest nicht trotz KI, sondern mit ihr. Wer bei uns anfängt, gibt Feedback, das in Produktentscheidungen einfließt — und versteht irgendwann, warum ein Prompt besser funktioniert als ein anderer. Und weil wir schnell wachsen, ist vieles bei uns noch im Entstehen. Manche Antwort lautet ehrlicherweise „das bauen wir gerade noch”. Genau darin liegt die Chance: Du triffst auf Freiräume statt auf fertige Strukturen, und was du hier aufbaust, trägt deine Handschrift. Was wir bieten Arbeit mit echter KI-Technologie auf internationalem Niveau — nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Geschäftsmodell. Echter Gestaltungsspielraum. Deine Ideen landen nicht in einem Ideenbriefkasten, sondern in der nächsten Iteration. Kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen, nicht in Gremienschleifen. Wachstum, das du mitgehst. Wir bauen gerade die nächste Unternehmensphase — mit Rollen, Verantwortung und Perspektiven, die es vor einem Jahr noch nicht gab. Hauptarbeitsort Leipzig mit regelmäßiger Büropräsenz und flexiblem Homeoffice-Anteil. Hybride Modelle sind bei uns gelebte Praxis, nicht die Ausnahme. Unbefristeter Vertrag, Vollzeit. Leistungsprämien für nachweisbare Erfolge. Mehrtägige Teamevents an Orten, die tatsächlich Spaß machen. So läuft unser Bewerbungsprozess Intro-Interview — wir lernen uns kennen, du erfährst, wo wir stehen und wohin wir wollen. Leadership Study oder Technical Study , je nach Rolle — ein echtes Problem aus unserem Alltag, das wir gemeinsam durchgehen. Founder Interview Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Wir sind das Technologieunternehmen, das den Gruppen- und Veranstaltungsverkauf in der Hotellerie neu denkt. description: About the Team It’s an exciting time to join our rapidly growing Accounting team with ample development opportunities. We're growing the Revenue Data team with Engineering and Accounting Data openings to drive our automation and systems infrastructure and while keeping pace within one of the fastest growing marketplace companies. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you will develop engineers, shape the team’s roadmap and remain close to delivery, ensuring our data products are reliable, scalable and well governed. You will partner with Finance, Accounting and cross-functional Engineering teams to translate complex operational and regulatory requirements into automated, auditable solutions. We are looking for someone with strong Data Engineering and distributed-systems experience, including building production data pipelines and platforms at scale. Experience supporting Finance or Accounting workflows is beneficial, but we are primarily looking for an exceptional technical leader who can grow into the domain. You will report to the Senior Manager, M&A Accounting (Data), within the Accounting Revenue Data team in our Finance organisation. You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… Own the strategic roadmap and execution for DoorDash's accounting infrastructure, including the data pipelines, system integrations, and automation platforms that power financial reporting, reconciliation, and compliance at scale. Partner with Accounting, Finance, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate complex regulatory and operational requirements into reliable, auditable backend systems. Lead and mentor a team of engineers, setting technical direction and fostering a high-performance culture within a fast-moving, high-stakes financial environment. Drive measurable improvements in data accuracy, pipeline reliability, and system scalability — directly enabling faster close cycles and audit readiness across the organization. AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

GTM Engineering at LILT

As LILT scales, more of our go-to-market motion is powered by agentic AI, systems that can research, enrich, sequence, and act on our behalf, not just report on what already happened. This role sits at the center of that shift. You'll be the builder who turns "we should automate this" into a working, reliable system, owning the tools and automations that keep Marketing, Sales, and RevOps running smoothly.

Examples of the kinds of systems that live in this role:

  • AI-driven meeting and lead qualification agents that compile evidence from across our stack to make a judgment

  • Account signal-scoring systems that combine data into a ranked, defensible view of where the team should spend its time

  • AI-drafted outbound at scale, personalized from live account context

These are illustrative rather than a fixed backlog. The specific builds will change; the shape of the work won't.

Where You'll Work

This role is based in our London office. We work in a hybrid model, with team members in the office 3 days per week to collaborate, brainstorm, and build together. You'll get the energy and creativity of in-person work, combined with the flexibility to focus from home when needed.

What You'll Do

This high-impact, hands-on role is responsible for owning LILT's agentic GTM systems: proposing, designing, building, and maintaining the AI-driven tools and automations that power our go-to-market engine, including our Clay-based enrichment and outbound workflows. You'll also play a critical role in optimizing our go-to-market technology stack, streamlining our lead-to-opportunity process, and helping to maintain day-to-day department operations.

You'll work closely with GTM leadership across Sales Development, Sales, Marketing, and Operations and Systems functions to drive process optimization and overall efficiency. You'll recommend, build, and run cross-functional projects and process improvements that directly impact our operational efficiency and top-line growth of all revenue lines. You'll contribute to the strategy and execution of full-funnel programs that drive predictable, scalable pipeline.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Agentic business systems integration. Propose, design, build, and maintain agentic AI tools and automations that connect and orchestrate our GTM stack end-to-end, reducing manual work and increasing the speed and reliability of our lead-to-revenue motion.

  • Own Clay and the automation stack. Serve as our resident expert on Clay (and similar enrichment/orchestration tools), building and maintaining tables, waterfalls, and workflows that keep our data accurate and our outbound motion running.

  • Salesforce lead-to-opportunity. Partner closely with RevOps to own the workflow from a new lead entering the system, through the various lead stages, and converting to an opportunity, including routing, assignment, and the rules that decide who works what.

  • Full-funnel ownership. Design and optimize the entire lead funnel, from top-of-funnel acquisition through MQL to SQL handoff, driving higher conversion and increased velocity.

  • Lead and contact data integrity. Work with internal tools and external vendors to maintain a high quality database of contacts across our target industries and personas.

  • Partner with Sales. Align tightly with revenue leadership to define pipeline goals, campaign targeting, SLAs, and lead management workflows. Sit close enough to the reps to know which parts of the process actually hurt.

  • Fuel growth. Partner closely with the demand gen team to drive multi-channel campaigns across email marketing, webinars, paid media, SEO, events, outbound motions, and ABM to meet ambitious growth targets.

  • Use data to scale. Build a data-driven culture. Forecast, measure, and communicate program results, continuously optimizing for ROI and CAC efficiency.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Work across demand gen, product marketing, ADRs, and sales ops to build cohesive, conversion-optimized systems and campaigns.

  • Department operations. Help with department-level planning for things like managing campaign budget, team meetings and activities, and annual planning.

  • Documentation and knowledge continuity. Maintain living documentation (Notion) for every agent and workflow you own, to a standard where a new team member or another AI agent could pick up ownership without a live handover call. This is a stated expectation of the role, not an afterthought.

Our Stack

  • CRM and RevOps: Salesforce, Default

  • Enrichment and orchestration: Clay, ZoomInfo

  • Outbound and conversation intelligence: Amplemarket, Trellus

  • Inbound and web conversion: Qualified

  • Marketing automation: HubSpot

  • Analytics: GA4, Salesforce reporting, Looker Studio

  • Build environment: Python, LLM APIs, agentic coding tools, Notion for documentation

Skills and Experience

  • 3-5 years in B2B SaaS or AI/ML go-to-market engineering, RevOps, or marketing operations, with a track record of building automations that actually ship.

  • Hands-on Clay expertise. You've built waterfall enrichment, scoring, and routing in Clay (or a comparable tool), and you can take a new use case from idea to live quickly.

  • Agentic AI and automation fluency. Comfortable proposing, designing, and building agentic workflows and integrations using APIs, webhooks, and orchestration tools, to connect systems and eliminate manual work.

  • Working proficiency in Python/other languages for building and maintaining AI agent pipelines. Comfortable working inside an existing codebase, not just writing standalone scripts.

  • Comfortable reasoning about tradeoffs under cost and token constraints. You can explain not just what you built, but why you didn't build the more expensive or more complex version.

  • Strong Salesforce fundamentals. You can build reports, understand the object model and the automation layer, and use what you find to change how the funnel actually performs.

  • A point of view on where AI in GTM is heading. We'll ask. We're less interested in whether we agree than in whether you've thought about it seriously.

  • Obsessed with the metrics that matter: MQLs, pipeline, bookings, funnel conversion, velocity, CAC, and ROI.

  • Familiarity with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot or similar) a plus.

  • Ability to build relationships and work cross-functionally.

  • Smart, curious, and hard-working.

  • Natural collaborator and communicator, comfortable presenting to executives, boards, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

LILT in the News

Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times , and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab. Functions of the Role As Director of Systems Delivery , you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments. We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory ; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements. Commercial Scoping Support : Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability. Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting. Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement. Strong communication skills with key stakeholders, including executive, technical, and customer audiences. Willingness and eligibility to travel internationally to customer sites as required. Experience - Desirable Direct technical background in quantum computing systems, cryogenic systems, silicon platforms, or HPC architectures. Experience establishing post-delivery field support, service handoffs, or customer support operations for complex hardware. Experience scaling system assembly and delivery operations within a deep-tech environment. Experience supporting hardware/software technical scoping for commercial proposals. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.
 
Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab.


Functions of the Role

As Director of Systems Delivery, you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. 

You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments.

We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements.

  • Full-Stack System Execution: Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs.

  • Site Infrastructure Readiness: Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment.

  • Acceptance Testing & Governance: Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols.

  • Service & Operational Handoff: Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime.

  • Process Standardisation: Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. 

  • Supply Chain Management: Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines.                                                                  

  • Commercial Scoping Support: Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability.


Experience - Essentials

  • Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times.

  • Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints.

  • Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams.

  • Track record of taking first-of-a-kind physical hardware platforms from prototype to repeatable deployment models.

  • Hands-on experience managing facility readiness and running structured customer acceptance protocols.

  • Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting.

  • Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement.

  • Strong communication skills with key stakeholders, including executive, technical, and customer audiences. Willingness and eligibility to travel internationally to customer sites as required.


Experience - Desirable

  • Direct technical background in quantum computing systems, cryogenic systems, silicon platforms, or HPC architectures.

  • Experience establishing post-delivery field support, service handoffs, or customer support operations for complex hardware.

  • Experience scaling system assembly and delivery operations within a deep-tech environment. Experience supporting hardware/software technical scoping for commercial proposals.

raw.title: Atlassian Senior Consultant - ITSM/ESM Practice
raw.description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. With a strong focus on the modern workforce, the company helps customers reimagine service delivery beyond IT, streamline cross-functional workflows, and improve flow and throughput for engineering teams. For more information, visit https://valiantys.com.


Job Summary

As a Senior Solution Consultant – ITSM, you will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, helping them translate business and service management challenges into practical, scalable solutions built on Atlassian tools and industry best practices.

You will lead discovery and solution design, guide customers through ITSM transformation, and own the solution intent throughout delivery. Working closely with Technical Consultants, Technical Architects, Project Managers, Engagement Managers, and Sales, you will ensure solutions remain feasible, aligned with customer needs, and focused on measurable outcomes.

 

What You’ll Be Working On

Discover & Advise

  • Lead discovery and scoping workshops to understand customer objectives, pain points, processes, constraints, maturity, and desired outcomes
  • Analyze and challenge existing service management processes and recommend practical improvements based on ITSM and Atlassian leading practices
  • Translate customer requirements into solution themes, priorities, success measures, and implementation considerations
  • Advise customers across ITSM practices such as incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset and configuration management, service portals, and service operations
  • Facilitate conversations with business and technical stakeholders and identify where additional specialist expertise is required

    • Design & Shape Solutions

    • Translate business needs into high-level solution designs, roadmaps, configuration blueprints, and implementation-ready recommendations
    • Design scalable ITSM solutions leveraging Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian ecosystem
    • Produce clear deliverables including discovery outputs, current-state and future-state process maps, Solution Design Documents, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision logs, and requirements traceability
    • Document assumptions, dependencies, design decisions, trade-offs, and unresolved questions to maintain a shared understanding of the solution
    • Collaborate with Technical Consultants and Technical Architects to validate feasibility, scalability, integrations, automation, reporting, and platform constraints

      • Own & Guide Delivery

      • Own the solution intent throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring requirements, design decisions, acceptance criteria, and business outcomes remain visible during delivery
      • Support delivery teams by clarifying business context, requirements, design rationale, and customer priorities when questions or trade-offs arise
      • Facilitate solution checkpoints, design reviews, and working sessions with business and technical stakeholders
      • Partner with Project Managers and Technical Leads to maintain alignment between the approved solution design and delivered outcomes
      • Help ensure solutions remain appropriate for the customer’s maturity, constraints, and stated success measures

        • Support Pre-Sales & Client Growth

        • Support pre-sales activities with discovery insights, solution recommendations, effort assumptions, delivery considerations, and scope clarification
        • Contribute to proposals and Statements of Work where solution design, assumptions, acceptance criteria, dependencies, or delivery risks need to be clarified
        • Identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and scope boundaries before opportunities transition into delivery
        • Build and maintain trusted customer relationships throughout the engagement lifecycle
        • Identify opportunities for optimization, expansion, or follow-on advisory work and collaborate with the appropriate Sales or Engagement owner

          • Contribute & Grow

          • Mentor Consultants on discovery, advisory practices, solution documentation, and customer-facing communication
          • Contribute to internal playbooks, discovery frameworks, reusable ITSM solution assets, process maps, and delivery templates
          • Share knowledge and leading practices across the Solution Consulting and wider Delivery teams
          • Use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, documentation, synthesis, quality review, and knowledge reuse while ensuring outputs remain accurate and customer-specific
          • Stay current with developments across the Atlassian ecosystem and trends in ITSM, ESM, Agile, Work Management, automation, reporting, and enterprise collaboration
          • Maintain and develop your expertise through continuous learning and relevant certifications
 

Do You Have What It Takes?

To succeed in this role, you bring:

  • Significant experience in ITSM consulting, solution consulting, or service management transformation
  • Strong knowledge of Jira Service Management and the Atlassian ecosystem
  • Demonstrated experience leading customer discovery, requirements, and solution design workshops
  • Strong understanding of ITSM practices, including incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset and configuration management
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into practical solution designs and implementation recommendations
  • Experience producing high-quality customer-facing solution documentation, process maps, requirements, and acceptance criteria
  • Ability to balance customer expectations, business outcomes, platform capabilities, technical constraints, and delivery realities
  • Experience collaborating with technical consultants, architects, project managers, and commercial teams
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the development of less experienced consultants
  • Atlassian and/or ITIL certifications are a plus

    • Your strengths

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
    • Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management abilities
    • Ability to engage confidently with both business and technical stakeholders
    • Consultative mindset with the ability to challenge constructively and influence decisions
    • Ability to simplify complex requirements and turn them into clear, actionable solutions
    • Strong sense of ownership while working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams
    • Proactive and pragmatic approach to solving customer challenges
    • Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality deliverables
    • Customer-focused approach with a strong orientation toward measurable outcomes
    • Ability to mentor and support the growth of other consultants

      • Why Join Valiantys?

      At Valiantys, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.

      Meaning : Drive strategic transformation projects and influence outcomes
      Learning : Continuous development through training, certifications, and communities
      Flexibility : Hybrid work model supporting work-life balance

      Additional benefits:

      • International and multicultural environment
      • Flexible remote work policy
      • Meal vouchers
      • 100% covered health insurance (for you and your family)
      • Choice of equipment (PC or Mac)
      • Supportive and collaborative culture

        • Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to personal background, identity, or beliefs.

title: Director, Customer Support Network Strategy, Service Design & Workforce Management
description: <p>Wolt and Roo operate under the DoorDash umbrella, and Customer Support sits at the intersection of brand experience, unit economics and long-term growth. This role owns the strategy on:</p> <ol> <li>Where should we operate support, at what scale, and at what cost, across a rolling multi-year horizon?</li> <li>How do we architect frontline service design to be AI-ready as frontline tooling evolves, deliver best-in-class customer experience, and remain cost-efficient?</li> <li>How do we manage our workforce with precision, eliminating waste, consolidating overlapping structures, and continuously improving headcount efficiency through automation and org redesign?</li> </ol> <p>This is a permanent leadership role. The person in this seat will own network strategy, service design and workforce management as a continuous discipline, embedding deeply into Wolt, Roo and DoorDash technology stacks, building and refreshing the financial and operational case for change, and evolving the execution roadmap as the business, technology and market shift.</p> <h2><strong>Scope of Responsibility</strong></h2> <h3><strong>A. Support Service Design</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the demand and supply planning, and scheduling for the network, partnering deeply with upstream business owners and defect elimination to enable forecasting accuracy.&nbsp;</li> <li>Own ongoing assessment of how service is structured and delivered at the frontline across both brands.</li> <li>Maintain the role architecture map: what roles exist, what they do, where they overlap.</li> <li>Evaluate how tools (CRM, WFM, knowledge base, AI tools, ticketing) enable or constrain frontline roles, and keep this view current as tooling changes.</li> <li>Own and evolve the target-state frontline model aligned to AI-augmented ways of working.</li> <li>Continuously run gap analysis: current state vs. target state, with prioritised interventions.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>B. Support Site Strategy</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the support site footprint across both brands as an ongoing portfolio.</li> <li>Maintain and refresh strategic site scenarios across cost, quality, risk and scalability as conditions change.</li> <li>Own the financial model underpinning site strategy: OpEx, CapEx, transition cost, and planning cycles.</li> <li>Continuously assess BPO vs. in-house mix, nearshore vs. offshore trade-offs, and consolidation opportunities.</li> <li>Bring forward exec-ready recommendations as circumstances warrant, with clear pros, cons and decision criteria.</li> <li>Keep the site strategy framed against contact volume reduction through automation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>C. Workforce Management Transformation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own WFM maturity across both brands on an ongoing basis: demand forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management.</li> <li>Identify and close tooling gaps and duplication across Wolt and Roo WFM stacks.</li> <li>Own and evolve the consolidated WFM target operating model.</li> <li>Own the continuous efficiency case, driven through:</li> <ul> <li>Org consolidation:&nbsp; merging duplicated WFM roles across the two brands.</li> <li>Contact automation: defect elimination and end-to-end customer-facing automation.</li> <li>AI-assisted agent workflows: human-in-the-loop bot interfaces, AI-guided resolution, next-best-action tools.</li> <li>Scheduling and real-time optimisation via AI/ML tooling.</li> </ul> <li>Own tooling requirements and vendor strategy (shortlists, entries, exits) as an ongoing responsibility.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>D. DoorDash Technology Integration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Maintain deep, current working knowledge of DoorDash's support technology stack.</li> <li>Continuously translate technology capabilities into concrete business levers for the Wolt and Roo context.</li> <li>Own the dependency map between integration milestones and the Support transformation roadmap.</li> <li>Flag risks early where integration timelines could affect strategy execution.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>E. Execution Planning</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the rolling execution plan: prioritised initiatives, owners, investment, expected outcomes, refreshed as priorities shift.</li> <li>Own the forward-looking roadmap: strategic bets, sequencing logic, capability-build requirements.</li> <li>Own stakeholder alignment across Support Operations, Product, Finance and People functions on an ongoing basis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Core Ongoing Responsibilities &amp;</strong> Outcomes</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Current state visibility:</strong> Maintain a living view of service design, site footprint, financial planning cycles and WFM maturity across Wolt &amp; Roo, with an opinionated, forward-looking perspective on where the network needs to go.</li> <li><strong>DoorDash technology translation:</strong> Continuously map DoorDash technology capabilities to Wolt/Roo business levers, tracking upstream product, tooling and integration roadmaps and their implications for network design.</li> <li><strong>Support site strategy:</strong> Maintain a multi-year scenario model with full financial analysis, pros &amp; cons, and a standing recommended path, developed in partnership with the wider Strategy and Operations organisation.</li> <li><strong>Planning mechanisms:</strong> Own and run weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual mechanisms for demand and supply planning (long and short term) and scheduling/real-time management, optimising for customer experience and efficiency, with clear visibility for executive leadership.</li> <li><strong>WFM transformation:</strong> Own the consolidated operating model, tooling spec, and the efficiency case for the organisation, with signed-off financial projections refreshed as the business evolves.</li> <li><strong>Roadmap ownership:</strong> Maintain a rolling forward roadmap covering strategic sequencing, capability investments, and automation maturity milestones, ratified through regular leadership review.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder alignment:</strong> Keep all key workstream owners briefed, committed and clear on accountabilities on an ongoing basis.</li> </ul> <p>All recommendations must be underpinned by a financial model, and must be decision-ready on first presentation.</p> <h2><strong>Operating Rhythm</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Embed &amp; Orient (ongoing as scope evolves):</strong> Maintain stakeholder maps; stay immersed in Wolt, Roo &amp; DoorDash systems; keep baseline data current; revisit scope and success criteria as the business changes.</li> <li><strong>Diagnose:</strong> Continuously reassess current state across all workstreams; keep DoorDash tech translation current; surface risks and quick wins as they emerge.</li> <li><strong>Design &amp; Model:</strong> Maintain and evolve site strategy scenarios, the frontline service design blueprint, the WFM target model, and supporting financial models.</li> <li><strong>Synthesise &amp; Align:</strong> Run regular executive forums and stakeholder sign-off cycles.</li> <li><strong>Roadmap &amp; Continuity:</strong> Maintain the forward roadmap; ensure knowledge is embedded across the team rather than concentrated in one person.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Required Competencies</strong></h2> <table> <tbody> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Competency</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>What Good Looks Like</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Strategic clarity</p> </td> <td> <p>Translates complexity into a small number of decisive choices. Never produces a report that fails to recommend.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Financial rigour</p> </td> <td> <p>Builds robust P&amp;L and scenario models independently. Understands how operational levers flow to unit economics.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>CX &amp; support operations depth</p> </td> <td> <p>Credible across service design, contact centre strategy, WFM and automation.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>AI &amp; tooling fluency</p> </td> <td> <p>Understands AI automation in a CX context: IVR/chatbot design, agent assist tools, LLM-powered workflows.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Speed to competence</p> </td> <td> <p>Gets up to speed fast on unfamiliar technology stacks. Can read a product and understand business implications without hand-holding.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Stakeholder influence</p> </td> <td> <p>Earns trust quickly at VP level and above. Drives alignment without authority. Comfortable challenging conventional thinking.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Structured communication</p> </td> <td> <p>Writes concisely and presents with clarity.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Operator's mindset</p> </td> <td> <p>Thinks in outcomes and owns them over time.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <h2><strong>Experience Profile</strong></h2> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years in customer support strategy, CX operations or contact centre consulting/leadership.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience designing and executing site strategy at scale (multi-site, multi-brand, international).</li> <li>Deep workforce management expertise: forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management.</li> <li>Experience leading or sponsoring automation programmes, contact reduction, chatbot, AI agent-assist.</li> <li>Track record of delivering headcount efficiencies without degrading quality.</li> <li>Strong financial modelling capability, built business cases independently.</li> <li>Experience working inside or alongside a fast-growth tech company or marketplace.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Highly Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct experience in food delivery, logistics or three-sided marketplace support.</li> <li>Prior exposure to DoorDash, Wolt or comparable platforms.</li> <li>Background delivering inside complex integrations or M&amp;A contexts.</li> <li>Familiarity with WFM platforms (e.g. Verint, AWS Connect, Assembled, Calibrio) and CX tooling (e.g. Zendesk, Intercom).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Ways of Working</strong></h2> <ul> <li>This is a hands-on leadership role.&nbsp;</li> <li>The role requires deep, ongoing immersion in internal data, systems and teams.</li> <li>All recommendations must arrive decision-ready.</li> <li>The role operates with a high degree of autonomy, with regular visibility to leadership through written updates and reviews.</li> <li>Escalation discipline: flag blockers fast. loan and cycle to work scheme.</li> <li>Enhanced family friendly policies to support new parents.</li> <li>Social and Cultural Events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.</li> <li>Inspirational Talks, bringing the outside in with regular guest speakers and events.</li> <li>Learning and Development, supporting your growth with raw.description:
About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

 

The opportunity

As Associate Director, Platform Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the hybrid compute infrastructure, developer platform and scientific compute environments that power Relation’s machine learning and drug discovery work. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will work closely with your team and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

Our platform spans on-premises infrastructure and public cloud environments, supporting computational scientist notebooks through Kubeflow, model training and serving, internal services and genomic pipelines. You will set the technical direction across these areas, build and develop the team responsible for delivering them, and ensure our platform continues to evolve alongside the needs of our science.

Day to day, you will

  • Partner with the VP of Engineering and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

  • Own the architectural strategy for our Kubernetes-based clusters and broader hybrid infrastructure, setting the technical standards and guardrails within which the team designs, builds and operates.

  • Lead and develop the Platform Engineering team, hiring and retaining exceptional engineers, setting clear expectations and creating the conditions for them to do their best work.

  • Own the scientific compute platform, ensuring it reliably and efficiently meets the evolving needs of our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

  • Drive the maturity of our CI/CD pipelines, internal services and developer tooling, treating the platform as a product and our internal engineers and computational scientists as its customers.

  • Establish comprehensive observability and robust disaster recovery and failover strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Own Relation’s platform security controls, including IAM, secrets management, network policy and vulnerability management, ensuring the platform meets the data governance standards required of a clinical-stage biotech working with sensitive patient-derived data.

 

Professionally, you will have

  • Significant experience in platform, infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with a strong track record of building and operating complex production environments.

  • Experience leading engineers, either formally or informally, with responsibility for significant workstreams from strategy through to delivery. You have set technical direction others have followed, mentored and developed engineers, and taken accountability for live production systems.

  • Strong hands-on operational experience. You have participated in on-call rotations for production infrastructure, led responses to significant incidents and driven the subsequent changes required to prevent recurrence.

  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes, alongside experience operating infrastructure across hybrid on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Experience building, running or evolving MLOps infrastructure, ideally including notebook environments such as Kubeflow, GPU compute for distributed training and model serving.

  • Familiarity with batch compute for data-intensive scientific workloads, with an understanding of the reliability, scalability and reproducibility requirements of scientific data pipelines.

  • A track record of maturing CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling and observability across complex, multi-environment platforms.

  • Strong security fundamentals, with hands-on experience designing and implementing appropriate security controls.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to co-own strategy with senior stakeholders, challenge decisions constructively and communicate platform strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Bonus Experience:

  • Exposure to relevant compliance and governance frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR within a research or scientific environment.

 

Personally, you

  • Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

  • Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

  • Technically deep enough to earn the respect of a highly skilled engineering team, while being equally comfortable influencing and contributing at leadership level

  • Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

  • Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

  • Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

 

Working Style & Culture at Relation

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting!

 

Recruitment Agencies

Please note that Relation does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Resumes should not be forwarded to our job aliases or employees. Relation will not be liable for any fees associated with unsolicited CVs.

title: Senior Performance Lead - Trade Acquisition
description: As our next Senior Performance Marketing Lead, Trade Acquisition , you'll take single-point accountability for how we grow trade supply through paid channels. This isn't about hitting numbers someone else set. It's about setting the goals, building the roadmap and owning the strategy that the whole trade acquisition function is measured against. You'll shape how we invest, what we prioritise, and how the acquisition engine evolves over the next 12 to 24 months, working alongside senior stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product and Finance. Forget long lists, here’s what you’ll actually spend your time on: Set the paid acquisition strategy: build the annual and quarterly plan that translates our business goals into clear channel priorities, investment and targets, rather than delivering against a plan set elsewhere. Own PPC, paid social, affiliates and remarketing end-to-end, covering strategy, budget, vendor relationships, testing and performance across each channel. Set and own the commercial targets that matter (MQLs, CAC and LTV:CAC), partnering closely with Finance on forecasting, unit models and the business case for new investment. Build a structured test-and-learn roadmap, sequencing initiatives across quarters and spotting risks such as rising CAC or channel saturation before they bite, while exploring new channels and partnerships as we grow. Partner with Sales, Product & CRO, CRM and Data teams to align lead quality, sharpen the acquisition journey and improve attribution and measurement. Report performance to senior stakeholders with a clear narrative on the mid to long-term health of the acquisition engine, not just in-period results, and represent trade acquisition in planning forums. It’s not about ticking every box. It’s about turning up curious, ready to crack on. You’ll do well here if you bring: Experience (or eagerness to grow into) owning paid acquisition strategy across channels like PPC, paid social, affiliates or remarketing. You give sharp critique. You enjoy working in dynamic environments, solving complex problems, and creating thoughtful, user-centred design solutions that make a real impact.</p> <h4><strong>Skills &amp; experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Problem definition. </strong>You shape the problem, not just the pixels. Using research, data and the input of others, you break the ambiguity down and package it back up into something the team can build. The signal is evidence you helped define the right problem, not just made the screens.</li> <li><strong>Visual craft.</strong> Non-negotiable. Typography, spacing, colour, motion and micro-interactions, used with intent, not decoration. Weak craft is a no, whatever the strategy talk.</li> <li><strong>Accessibility. </strong>You design inclusively without being asked. You know why the standard exists, not just what it says, and it shows in judgement calls a checklist cannot make.</li> <li><strong>Systems thinking. </strong>You design across surfaces, from mobile to emerging platforms like AI-native interfaces, and contribute to the system others build on. Infrastructure compounds. Single screens do not.</li> <li><strong>Product and commercial sense. </strong>You shaped what got built. Metrics, research and commercial awareness sit next to the work. Craft in isolation moves nothing.</li> <li><strong>Communication. </strong>Clear, specific, opinionated. You say what you decided and why, and you are just as clear on what you chose not to do and why.</li> <li><strong>Working in the open. </strong>You share early and often, and you use critique to sharpen the work. You lift the quality of every review you join.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>How you work with AI</strong></h5> <ul> <li>LLMs are already embedded in your workflow.</li> <li>You prototype in tools like Claude Code and Cursor to test ideas in real code, not just mock them up. Tighter build-measure-learn loops.</li> <li>The signal is workflow, not tool count. Judgement spent where it counts.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>The full stack</strong></h5> <p>We expect you to work end to end, from problem definition and research to information architecture and UX writing.</p> <ul> <li>Your own research and usability testing.</li> <li>Validation and experimentation. You set up A/B tests and read them honestly.</li> <li>UX writing. In a regulated market, this is craft and compliance at once.</li> <li>Problem definition. Break it down. Package it back up.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>Your portfolio</strong></h5> <p>Show problem solving that moved a commercial lever, not just well-made screens. We want evidence of the outcome, the craft behind it, the care in the finish, how you contributed to the Design System, and where AI tightened your process. How you write it says as much as what you show. Concise and clear is a signal of how you communicate. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.</p> <h5><strong>Experience</strong></h5> <p>Typically 5 to 8 years in product design, with a track record of owning problems end to end and influencing direction at a team level.</p> <h4><strong>Behaviours &amp; attitude</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Patient-first mindset.</strong> You put patient outcomes first. Every decision weighs commercial growth against clinical safety and care, and you don't let one erode the other. You understand real health journeys well enough to make them simple, accessible and worth trusting.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative creation. </strong>You work well across product, engineering and clinical, and you know a good idea can come from any of them. You listen to feedback and take it on, using it to make the work better.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity. </strong>You ask why before how. You stay curious about the patient, the problem and the tools you use to solve it, and you're comfortable being a beginner when something new is worth learning.</li> </ul> </div> <h3><strong>Why join Eucalyptus?</strong></h3> <p>Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (<a href="https://pilot.com.au/">Pilot,</a>&nbsp;<a href="http://www.kinfertility.com.au/">Kin</a>,&nbsp;<a href="http://skin.software/">Software</a>) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, and skincare.</p> <p><strong>Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>What’s next</strong> - Our goal for the next three years is to support <strong>1 million patients globally</strong> to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>Build something world-changing</strong> - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.</li> <li><strong>Make real impact</strong> - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.</li> <li><strong>Accelerate your growth</strong> - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.</li> <li><strong>Join a motivated team</strong> - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.</li> </ul> <h3>What’s ahead in the UK</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Opportunity to convert to an FTE role</strong> <ul> <li><strong>Become an owner</strong> – Your own stake in the business with our employee options program<br><strong>Invest in your growth</strong> – Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave<br><strong>Work flexibly</strong> – Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration<br><strong>Support your well-being</strong> – Private health insurance through Vitality or opt for a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you<br><strong>Take time off</strong> – 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Join a connected team</strong> – A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport, and seasonal events</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
